office_does: The three county commissioners adopt the budget, set policy and approve contracts; a District 3 commissioner is nominated in the district and elected county-wide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Commissioner Mark D. Letham (Prefers IND Party), appointed in January 2026 to succeed the retiring Gene Strong, is the only candidate for the rest of the term and the next four years.

candidates.summary: Appointed District 3 commissioner in January 2026 after Gene Strong retired; the only candidate.
highlights: Appointed by Resolution No. 05-26 in January 2026 [S3]
Voted with the board to put the county EMS levy on the November ballot [S4]
